panels.prompt: High wide shot, column of riders leaving marsh village west along raised dam through reeds and fog; leading young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back on chestnut mare with white blaze; knights behind
Medium shot, tall nordic woman, blonde braids, fur and chainmail, two-handed axe on horseback, axe resting on shoulder, wide wolfish grin; frosted road, thinning morning fog

texts.text: Наконец-то! Рагна уж думала, мы тут корни пустим.

panels.prompt: Two-shot riding side by side: japanese teen boy, black hair, blue eyes, noble cloak, glowing golden sword, eager and excited; young chinese woman, long black braid, dark-blue outfit, glowing white bow, stern, eyes forward; frosted road, morning fog

Wide shot, woman with short light-brown hair, tired grey eyes, round shield with green runes on log tavern porch beside huge ash tree, hand on shoulder of pointy-eared girl, watching riders leave, guarded; grey mist

Medium shot, lanky freckled boy in oversized felt hat running up to stirrup, holding up folded note to young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back on chestnut mare; roadside post, three old willows

texts.text: От Матиаса! Засаду у Жёлтого брода отбили!

panels.prompt: Close-up, gloved hand holding an unfolded paper note covered in smudged illegible scribbles, dark leather sleeve, chestnut horse mane behind; soft fog light

texts.text: Гринь и Кузьма взяты живыми. Ярош цел.
